_about: Water (1) + ethanol (2) + cyclohexane (3): isobaric vapour-liquid-liquid equilibrium at 101.3 kPa, from Gomis et al. (2005). Liquid I is the organic (cyclohexane-rich) liquid, liquid II the aqueous one. Rows as the ThermoML record stores them: T in K; in liquid I (the record's liquid mixture 1) the mole fractions of ethanol and of water; in liquid II (liquid mixture 2) those of ethanol and of water; in the vapour those of ethanol and of water. Cyclohexane is 1 minus the other two in each phase (not stored in the record). `uncertainties` holds the record's stated uncertainty of each mole fraction, in the same order.

source.citation: V. Gomis, A. Font, R. Pedraza, M. D. Saquete, Isobaric vapor liquid and vapor liquid liquid equilibrium data for the system water + ethanol + cyclohexane, Fluid Phase Equilib. 235 (2005) 7-10
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1 (ethanol + cyclohexane + water; phases liquid mixture 1, gas, liquid mixture 2; 11 rows): v1 T; p1 ethanol and p4 water in liquid mixture 1; p2 ethanol and p5 water in liquid mixture 2; p3 ethanol and p6 water in the gas. The ternary azeotrope: the abstract on the ThermoML Archive page of the record. The table numbers in the article were not checked (article not open).

azeotrope.from: the abstract, as the ThermoML Archive page of the record prints it: "a ternary heterogeneous azeotrope at 335.6K with a composition of 0.188, 0.292, 0.520 mole fraction of water, ethanol and cyclohexane, respectively" (read 2026-11-17)

notes: Read with validation/python/thermoml_read.py on the record fetched from https://trc.nist.gov/ThermoML/10.1016/j.fluid.2005.07.015.xml on 2026-11-17, values as stored. The record's set 2 (27 VLE points with one liquid) is not transcribed. Used by test/columns-heteroazeotropic.test.js, the validated case of proposal 0024 (ethanol dehydration with cyclohexane and a decanter). The NRTL pairs were not fitted to these ternary data. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
